name: Mezbaur Are Rafi

headline.text: Linux servers, backend services and the integrations between them.

intro: I connect Shopify, Moodle, WordPress and payment gateways, and make sure the data moving through them stays correct in production. Mostly Node.js and TypeScript, plus whatever Moodle and WordPress require.
summary: At Pedago Academy I'm the primary in-house software engineer. I administer the production Moodle LMS, maintain the WordPress/WooCommerce platform, build the Node.js integrations for payments, authentication and automation, and run the Linux VPS infrastructure underneath them.

Most of the work is making separate systems agree: a Shopify order with an SSLCommerz payment, a Zoom session with a Moodle attendance record. I debug through logs and SQL, test payment flows end to end against the gateway's sandbox, and write things down — 20+ technical documents so far, from SOPs and deployment guides to disaster recovery plans.
